summary: No hot-path regressions in correctness terms; two non-blocking overheads introduced by the single-source resolvers: git_control_dir subprocess cost on every run_state_path call, and load_events directory fan-out replacing a single JSONL read.

non_blocking_findings.summary: git_control_dir (factory_lib.py:647) forks git twice (rev-parse --absolute-git-dir + --show-toplevel) and is now called by run_state_path on every invocation, including pre_tool_use on every tool call; not memoized. Consider an lru_cache keyed on root.

load_events (events.py:36) globs .factory/events/*.json and opens each file per call, versus one events.jsonl read before; O(events) file opens for history/board/doctor reads. Acceptable at current volumes; watch as event count grows.
